name: Tickets smoke test — Parts B to H

definition.title: Tickets smoke test — Parts B–H ({{run}})
definition.body_md: Phil's live check of everything Tickets shipped on 2026-09-17. Tick each step as you go; type what you saw into the answer boxes. Anything that fails: leave it unticked and add a comment on this ticket with the step id.

values.label: API token name you create in step 7.1

intro.verdict_html: Seven phases, about 40 minutes end to end. Phases 1–4 are the daily surfaces (Now, Inbox, ticket page, habits). Phase 5 is Telegram. Phase 6 is templates, steps and the weekly review. Phase 7 is tokens, the CLI and the two webhooks, which need secrets you set yourself.
prerequisites: Signed in on the phone and the PC
Ten minutes of quiet for phase 5 — it sends real messages
For 7.5: CRON_SECRET in your shell; for 7.4 / 7.6: the two webhook secrets — see ticket MYC-127 and docs/tokens.md. Phase 7 is setup plus verification; do it once, then re-runs skip it.

phases.title: Now view and the dashboard
phases.lede_html: The same list should appear in three places.

steps.title: Open Tickets from the Organisation sidebar; the Now tab is selected
Tap Home, then Out, then reload — the Where chip sticks

fields.label: How many tickets Now shows with + backlog on

steps.title: Switch Energy to Low; the list shrinks to ≤2-point tickets and unpointed ones
Open the dashboard; the Now block shows the same top three and its ? sheet names the facets
Press ⌘K / Ctrl-K, type MYC-97, Enter — the Move habit ticket opens

verify_html: Now on the tab, the Today block and the Now card agree
phases.why_html: One query builder serves all three surfaces; the FROZEN scorer only orders.

phases.title: Inbox, Clarify and Backlog triage

steps.title: Inbox tab → Triage backlog: defer three tickets to Next with contexts (Where, Tool, When, points)
On one card use Multi-step: add two sub-tasks, then Defer → Next; open the ticket and see both sub-tasks
On one card use Delegate: pick a person → the ticket lands in Waiting with their name on the row
Next tab → Select → tick two → Move to Doing from the bar; the Doing count rises by two
Long-press a row on the phone: bulk mode opens with that row selected

verify_html: Counts on the tabs change as you move tickets
Nothing you clarified reappears in the triage stack

phases.title: The ticket page

steps.title: Open a Doing ticket: move it Next → Doing → Verify with the status pills; the classic Tasks view shows the same status
Set a deadline and a scheduled date; change Where/Tool/When/points; reload — all kept
Add a link (any https URL) and a comment; both appear; remove the link with ×
Add a checklist (one step per line), tick a step — the progress bar moves and Activity logs the step
Move it to Done, tap Verified live, then unverify, then Reopen → Next
Toggle Simple statuses in the Tickets header; the pills collapse to Todo / Doing / Waiting / Done

verify_html: The activity list at the bottom records the moves

phases.title: Habits

steps.title: Dashboard Habits tile: tap a habit; reload — it stays lit; tap again to clear
Open /organisation/habits — the heatmap still shows your history and today's toggles match the tile
Edit habits → rename one → save; the tile shows the new name (it is a ticket: MYC-97…108)

verify_html: No habit rows appear in Now, the GTD tabs or the classic Tasks list

phases.title: Telegram — capture, reminders, check-in

steps.title: Send: "call the garage about the MOT" → reply shows a key with 📱 phone · office hours and Next / Someday / Bin buttons; tap Next
Send a photo with the caption "return the kettle" → the reply says 📎 attached; open the ticket: the attachment link opens the image
Send: "remind me in 2 minutes to stretch" → reminder set; within ~15 min a ⏰ message arrives with Done / +1h / Tomorrow; tap Done
Schedule any ticket for today, then at your check-in time (Settings default 18:00) a 📍 message lists it; tap Tomorrow — its date moves

notes.html: To test now instead of waiting: run the cron with ?force=1 (step 7.5).

steps.title: Tomorrow morning: the briefing has a 🎫 TICKETS block (today / overdue / verify)

verify_html: Every button press edits the message with a one-line result
The Reminders page (/reminders) lists the reminder you sent

phases.title: Templates, run-books, rundowns, weekly review

steps.title: Templates → Sync repo templates → New from template "Start a return" (item: kettle) → a ticket with five sub-tasks opens
New from template "Production cutover run-book": the house-style page renders phases, actor chips, copy blocks, value boxes; fill "Branch" and see it substituted in the ship command
On the kettle ticket press Plan this → a rundown appears within ~30 s with sources; Regenerate works

fields.label: Did the rundown cite a real page?

steps.title: Open the weekly review, walk the seven steps, act on one item in each non-empty step, then Seal
Open /review — the Tickets block shows the counts and "review sealed"

verify_html: The sealed week appears as an activity row on the Weekly review ticket

phases.title: Tokens, CLI, webhooks (PC)
phases.lede_html: Needs secrets you set yourself; the webhooks stay dormant until then.

steps.title: Settings → Security → API tokens: create one named {{token_name}} for MYC with write; copy it once
In a shell set the token and list your Doing tickets

shells.bash:
export MYCELIUM_URL=https://mycelium.sporebit.com MYCELIUM_TICKETS_TOKEN=mtk_…
cd /a/Projects/Mycelium && npm run tix -- ls --list doing
shells.ps:
$env:MYCELIUM_URL='https://mycelium.sporebit.com'; $env:MYCELIUM_TICKETS_TOKEN='mtk_…'
cd A:\Projects\Mycelium; npm run tix -- ls --list doing

steps.title: Try a write outside scope: a token with read only should get 403 on `tix comment`

Set GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET on Vercel and add a repo webhook (push, pull_request, issues) → /api/tickets/github; push a commit with a key in its message → the ticket gains a commit link and moves to Verify
Run the check-in cron by hand and read the JSON (reminders / checkins / review_reminder)
Set VERCEL_WEBHOOK_SECRET and add a Vercel webhook (deployment.succeeded) → /api/tickets/vercel; after the next production deploy the Verify ticket from 7.4 is Done with deploy + smoke links
Export: open the backlog export and skim it

verify_html: A ticket closed by the Vercel webhook shows deploy + smoke links and done (unverified) in the export until you tap Verified live
phases.why_html: Automation sets Done with evidence; your live check is the separate verified signal (Flag 1).

troubleshooting.symptom: A chip on Now flickers back
troubleshooting.fix: check /api/settings/ui-prefs returns 200; the WHERE-clause fix shipped 2a00bd4

troubleshooting.cause: TELEGRAM_USER_ID missing in that Vercel environment
troubleshooting.fix: vercel env ls; add to Production and Preview

troubleshooting.cause: the key is not in the Vercel Production environment
troubleshooting.fix: add it under Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables, redeploy, retry

troubleshooting.cause: the ticket looks like code work
troubleshooting.fix: code plans come from the skill: tix plan KEY --body-file plan.md
raise TICKETS_RUNDOWN_CAP_PENCE or wait for next month
